test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, and C can do a piece of work in 3, 3, and 3 days respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 3 days

Time taken by C = 3 days

Work required = 3 times

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Total Work = LCM of times

Time = Work ÷ Total efficiency

&l
